aspect-of-the-crucible-breath.name: Aspect Of The Crucible: Breath

This incantation can be cast without delay after performing another action. It is said that in the time before the Erdtree, stones were the first weapons of the beasts who had gained intelligence.
bestial-sling.effectText: Swiftly flings numerous sharp rock shards

black-blade.description: Power gleaned from the remembrance of Maliketh.
black-blade.effectText: Black blade spinning slash that emits wave of light.

black-flame-ritual.effectText: Summons circle of black flame pillars around caster.

blessing-of-the-erdtree.effectText: Grants greater blessing to self and nearby allies

bloodflame-blade.name: Bloodflame Blade
bloodflame-blade.description: A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood. Engulfs armament held in the right hand with bloodflame. This incantation can be cast while in motion. After dealing damage, bloodflame continues to build up onset of blood loss for a very short time.

bloodflame-talons.name: Bloodflame Talons
bloodflame-talons.description: A Blood Oath incantation, granted by the Lord of Blood.
bloodflame-talons.effectText: Creates bloodflame lacerations that then explode

bloodboon.name: Bloodboon
bloodboon.description: Sacred incantation of Mohg, Lord of Blood.
bloodboon.effectText: Scatters bloodflame before caster to set area aflame.

borealiss-mist.name: Borealis's Mist
borealiss-mist.effectText: Spews icy breath of Borealis from above

cure-poison.effectText: Cures Poison ailment and reduces poison build-up.

burn-o-flame.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
burn-o-flame.effectText: Raises a series of flame pillars around caster

darkness.name: Darkness

darkness.effectText: Creates area of darkness that conceals caster

death-lightning.name: Death Lightning
death-lightning.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon
death-lightning.effectText: Strikes surroundings with storm of death lightning

discus-of-light.name: Discus Of Light
discus-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
discus-of-light.effectText: Fires ring of light before the caster

divine-fortification.name: Divine Fortification
divine-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

dragonbolt-blessing.name: Dragonbolt Blessing
dragonbolt-blessing.description: Superior incantation of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons lightning to bolster the caster's body. Attacks become easier to deflect and resistance to all ailments is increased. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Only those loved by dragons can survive the ordeal of cladding their bodies in lightning.

dragonice.name: Dragonice
dragonice.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
dragonice.effectText: Channels dragon to spew icy breath

dragonclaw.name: Dragonclaw
dragonclaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
dragonclaw.effectText: Channels dragon to rend foes with dragon claws

dragonfire.name: Dragonfire
dragonfire.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
dragonfire.effectText: Channels dragon to spew flame breath

dragonmaw.name: Dragonmaw
dragonmaw.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
dragonmaw.effectText: Channels dragon to bite foes before caster

ekzykes-decay.name: Ekzyke's Decay
ekzykes-decay.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.
ekzykes-decay.effectText: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above.

ekzykess-decay.name: Ekzykes's Decay
ekzykess-decay.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Ekzykes, the Decaying.
ekzykess-decay.effectText: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above

fires-deadly-sin.name: Fire's Deadly Sin
fires-deadly-sin.description: Incantation originating from a deeply ominous prophecy.
fires-deadly-sin.effectText: Sets area and self ablaze with raging flames

erdtree-heal.name: Erdtree Heal
erdtree-heal.description: One of the ancient Erdtree incantations.
erdtree-heal.effectText: Vastly heals HP for self and nearby allies

flame-fall-upon-them.name: Flame, Fall Upon Them
flame-fall-upon-them.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
flame-fall-upon-them.effectText: Hurls several balls of fire at once

ezykess-decay.name: Ezykes's Decay
ezykess-decay.description: Spews scarlet rot breath of Ekzykes from above

electrify-armament.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
electrify-armament.effectText: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

flame-fortification.name: Flame Fortification
flame-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

flame-of-the-fell-god.name: Flame Of The Fell God
flame-of-the-fell-god.description: This legendary incantation is one of several that draws directly from the power of the Fire Giants. Releases a ball of raging fire said to be inhabited by a fell god. The fireball floats toward enemies and explodes, setting the area ablaze. Arghanthy, the chief guardian of the Flame, had kept this incantation a well-kept secret until it was stolen by Adan. The fell god still lurks within the Fire Giants.
flame-of-the-fell-god.effectText: Summons raging fireball that explodes and sets the area ablaze

elden-stars.name: Elden Stars
elden-stars.description: This legendary incantation is the most ancient of those that derive from the Erdtree.
elden-stars.effectText: Creates a steam of golden shooting stars that assail the area.

flame-protect-me.name: Flame, Protect Me
flame-protect-me.description: The most ancient of the Fire Monks' incantations.

fortissaxs-lightning-spear.name: Fortissax's Lightning Spear
fortissaxs-lightning-spear.description: Incantation that channels the power of the ancient dragon Fortissax.
fortissaxs-lightning-spear.effectText: Stabs from above with two red lightning spears in tandem

frozen-lightning-spear.name: Frozen Lightning Spear
frozen-lightning-spear.description: Incantation that channels the power of the Dragonkin Soldiers. Creates a spear of ice lightning and stabs it into the ground from above. On impact, the spear will burst into trails of lightning advancing forwards. The Dragonkin were born in the Eternal City, where they knew no true sky, nor true lightning. Instead, ice lightning was their weapon.
frozen-lightning-spear.effectText: Stabs with ice lightning spear from above

glintstone-breath.name: Glintstone Breath
glintstone-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
glintstone-breath.effectText: Channels dragon to spew icy breath.

golden-lightning-fortification.name: Golden Lightning Fortification
golden-lightning-fortification.effectText: Greatly increases lightning resistance for self and allies

frenzied-burst.name: Frenzied Burst
frenzied-burst.description: Incantations originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
frenzied-burst.effectText: Emits concentrated blast of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

giantsflame-take-thee.name: Giantsflame Take Thee
giantsflame-take-thee.description: One of the incantations that draws directly from the power of the
giantsflame-take-thee.effectText: Hurls massive ball of raging fire

golden-vow-spell.name: Golden Vow (spell)
golden-vow-spell.effectText: Increases attack and defense for self and allies

gurrangs-beast-claw.name: Gurrang's Beast Claw
gurrangs-beast-claw.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
gurrangs-beast-claw.effectText: Creates beast claws to rend surroundings with shockwaves

immutable-shield.name: Immutable Shield
immutable-shield.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
heal.effectText: Heals HP for you and nearby allies.

howl-of-shabriri.name: Howl Of Shabriri
howl-of-shabriri.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
howl-of-shabriri.effectText: Shrieks, building up madness in nearby foes

great-heal.name: Great Heal
great-heal.description: Superior incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
great-heal.effectText: Greatly Heals HP for self and nearby allies

greyolls-roar.name: Greyoll's Roar
greyolls-roar.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Greyoll, the Elder Dragon. An incantation of legendary status.
greyolls-roar.effectText: Emits the roar of Elder Dragon Greyoll.

inescapable-frenzy.name: Inescapable Frenzy
inescapable-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
inescapable-frenzy.effectText: Latches onto foes to spread madness

honed-bolt.name: Honed Bolt
honed-bolt.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
honed-bolt.effectText: Strikes foe with lightning bolt from above

lansseaxs-glaive.name: Lansseax's Glaive
lansseaxs-glaive.description: Incantation that channels the powr of the ancient dragon Lansseax.
lansseaxs-glaive.effectText: Sweeps from above with red lightning glaive.

lightning-fortification.name: Lightning Fortification
lightning-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.

lords-aid.name: Lord's Aid
lords-aid.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
lords-aid.effectText: Alleviates poison / blood loss / sleep buildup for self / allies

lightning-spear.name: Lightning Spear
lightning-spear.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult. Summons a lightning spear and hurls it before the caster. Charging causes a lightning bolt to strike the point ofimpact. Long ago, Godwyn the Golden defeated the ancient dragon Fortissax, and befriended his fallen foe — an event that gave rise to the ancient dragon cult in the capital.

law-of-causality.name: Law Of Causality
law-of-causality.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
law-of-causality.effectText: Retaliates upon receiving a number of blows

litany-of-proper-death.name: Litany Of Proper Death
litany-of-proper-death.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
litany-of-proper-death.effectText: Creates image of Order to deal holy damage

law-of-regression.name: Law Of Regression
law-of-regression.description: Incantation of the Golden Order fundamentalists. One of the key fundamentals. Heals all negative statuses, dispels special effects, and reveals mimicry in all its forms. The fundamentalists describe the Golden Order through the powers of regression and causality. Regression is the pull of meaning; that all things yearn eternally to converge.
law-of-regression.effectText: Heals all ailments and dispels all special effects

lightning-strike.name: Lightning Strike
lightning-strike.description: One of the incantations of the capital's ancient dragon cult.
lightning-strike.effectText: Summons lightning bolt that spreads from impact.

lords-divine-fortification.name: Lord's Divine Fortification
lords-divine-fortification.description: Incantation taught to Gideon the All-Knowing by the Two
lords-divine-fortification.effectText: Greatly increases holy damage negation incl. allies

lords-heal.name: Lord's Heal
lords-heal.description: Incantation bestowed by the Two Fingers upon the Tarnished
lords-heal.effectText: Massively heals HP for self and nearby allies

order-healing.name: Order Healing
order-healing.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.

noble-presence.name: Noble Presence
noble-presence.description: Ancient power of the Godskin Nobles.
noble-presence.effectText: Thrust out belly with gusto to unelash repelling shockwave

orders-blade.name: Order's Blade
orders-blade.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Used by hunters of Those Who Live in Death. Enchants armament held in the right hand with holy-affinity attacks. This incantation is especially damaging to Those Who Live in Death. Any felled by this incantation cannot be revived. The role of the hunters is to stamp out defiled reason - all for the perfection of the Golden Order.
orders-blade.effectText: Enchanted right-hand armament with holy damage

magic-fortification.name: Magic Fortification
magic-fortification.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Increases magic damage negation. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Follow the path that has been set for you, and you will make enemies of all others: the monks, the sorcerers, the ancient dragon knights, and the scions of gold. Heed me – the Lands Between offers no welcome to the Tarnished.

o-flame.name: O, Flame!
o-flame.effectText: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand

magma-breath.name: Magma Breath
magma-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
magma-breath.effectText: Channels wyrm to spew magma breath

pest-threads.name: Pest Threads
pest-threads.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.
pest-threads.effectText: Launches countless sticky threads before caster

protection-of-the-erdtree.name: Protection Of The Erdtree
protection-of-the-erdtree.description: A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship. Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical, for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation. In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
protection-of-the-erdtree.effectText: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies

poison-armament.name: Poison Armament
poison-armament.description: Incantation of the servants of rot. Enchants armament held in the right hand with poison. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Those who dwell within poison know rot all too well. The death that begets life, that comes to all equally. That is to say: it is the cycle of rebirth put into practice.

placidusaxs-ruin.name: Placidusax's Ruin
placidusaxs-ruin.description: Power gleaned form the remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax.
placidusaxs-ruin.effectText: Spews golden breath of Dragonlord Placidusax

poison-mist.name: Poison Mist
poison-mist.description: Incantation of the servants of rot.

radagons-rings-of-light.name: Radagon's Rings Of Light
radagons-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists.
radagons-rings-of-light.effectText: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area

rotten-breath.name: Rotten Breath
rotten-breath.description: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion.
rotten-breath.effectText: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath

rejection.name: Rejection
rejection.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful.
rejection.effectText: Produces a shockwave that pushes away foes.

smarags-glintstone-breath.name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
smarags-glintstone-breath.effectText: Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above

stone-of-gurranq.name: Stone Of Gurranq
stone-of-gurranq.description: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman.
stone-of-gurranq.effectText: Hurls a boulder before the caster

surge-o-flame.name: Surge, O Flame!
surge-o-flame.description: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks.
surge-o-flame.effectText: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire

shadow-bait.name: Shadow Bait
shadow-bait.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers' sewants, who once served as the
shadow-bait.effectText: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build

scouring-black-flame.name: Scouring Black Flame
scouring-black-flame.description: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles. Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range. The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
scouring-black-flame.effectText: Sweeps area before caster with black flame

scarlet-aeonia.name: Scarlet Aeonia
scarlet-aeonia.description: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot.
scarlet-aeonia.effectText: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot.

swarm-of-flies.name: Swarm Of Flies
swarm-of-flies.description: A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power. Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
swarm-of-flies.effectText: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster

the-flame-of-frenzy.name: The Flame Of Frenzy
the-flame-of-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers.
the-flame-of-frenzy.effectText: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

theodorixs-magma.name: Theodorix's Magma
theodorixs-magma.description: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.
theodorixs-magma.effectText: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above

unendurable-frenzy.name: Unendurable Frenzy
unendurable-frenzy.description: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
unendurable-frenzy.effectText: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes.

triple-rings-of-light.name: Triple Rings Of Light
triple-rings-of-light.description: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Ivliquella to his father, Radagon.
triple-rings-of-light.effectText: Fire three rings of light before the caster

whirl-o-flame.name: Whirl, O Flame!
whirl-o-flame.description: Superior Incantation of the Fire Monks.
whirl-o-flame.effectText: Sweeps area before caster with stream of fire

vykes-dragonbolt.name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
vykes-dragonbolt.description: Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold.
vykes-dragonbolt.effectText: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

urgent-heal.name: Urgent Heal
urgent-heal.description: Incantation of the Two Fingers faithful.
urgent-heal.effectText: Heals a small amount of HP.

wrath-of-gold.name: Wrath Of Gold
wrath-of-gold.description: Superior Erdtree Worship incantation. Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave. This incantation was discovered when the Elden Ring was shattered, and it was feared as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.
wrath-of-gold.effectText: Produces golden shockwave that knocks back foes

catch-flame.name: Catch Flame
catch-flame.description: Incantation of the Fire Monks. Part of the Prophet starting set.
catch-flame.effectText: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand

assassins-approach.name: Assassin's Approach
assassins-approach.description: Incantation used by church assassins. Part of the Confessor starting set.
assassins-approach.effectText: Silences footsteps and reduces fall damage
